default.description: Default capability for the RagVault window. The shell does all privileged work in Rust, so the webview needs almost nothing.

remote-spa.description: The SPA is served over plain HTTP from 127.0.0.1, so WebView2 treats it as a remote origin. The port is pinned to the deterministic FALLBACK_PORTS range in src-tauri/src/main.rs. When all four fallback ports are busy the shell falls back to port 0 (OS-assigned); that origin is deliberately NOT granted here, so on the rare ephemeral-port launch the save-download capability is unavailable rather than wildcarding every local port.
